<thought>Since targeted searches returned no results, I will perform a broad search without any filtering criteria to retrieve a set of templates, then test each one for a match against the target molecule using the matching tool. This will let me identify a suitable carbonyl‑ene retrosynthetic template and obtain its ID and mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
